newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Mitac cuts '96 profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Mitac cuts '96 profit forecast.

text.p: Mitac International Corp, one of Taiwan's leading computer makers, said on Wednesday it was scaling back its 1996 pre-tax profit forecast by 51 percent to T$161 million from T$328 million.
Mitac, citing slowing sales in the global computer industry, also decided to cut its 1996 sales forecast to T$13 billion from T$17.5 billion, a company statement said.
It said the firm was optimistic about next year's outlooks as demand is expected to rise starting from the fourth quarter and 1997.
